ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA), Government of India

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.targetAudience: ST students studying in Classes 9 and 10
schemes.description: Financial assistance for Scheduled Tribe students studying in classes 9 and 10 in recognized schools to reduce dropout rates and encourage tribal youth to transition from elementary to secondary education.
eligibilityCriteria: Must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must be studying in Class 9 or Class 10 in a government or recognized school.
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rs. 2.50 Lakh).
Must not be holding any other scholarship under central/state government schemes for the same stage.
Must maintain regular attendance (minimum 50%) and satisfactory academic performance.
requiredDocuments: ST / Caste Certificate (issued by competent revenue authority)
Income Certificate for current academic year (from Tehsildar / SDO)
Previous Class Marksheet / Passing Certificate
School Bonafide / Enrollment Certificate with UDISE code
Student Aadhaar Card
Bank Passbook copy (Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT)
applicationProcedure: 1. Complete Student Profile in Tribal Scholar Saathi with Aadhaar verification.
2. Link DigiLocker to auto-fetch verified ST & Aadhaar certificates.
3. Select Pre-Matric Scholarship scheme and verify academic details.
4. Upload valid Income Certificate for current academic year.
5. Submit application for School / Headmaster verification.
verificationStages: Stage 1: School Verification by Headmaster / Principal
Stage 3: State Tribal Welfare Department approval
Stage 4: MoTA Sanction & DBT credit via PFMS
schemes.dbtInformation: Stipend and book grants are transferred directly into the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
importantConditions: Scholarship is tenable only in recognized government or aided schools.
Failure or dropout terminates the scholarship for that academic year.
Income certificate must be renewed every financial year.
schemes.officialSource: Ministry of Tribal Affairs Scheme Guidelines (scholarships.gov.in)

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.targetAudience: ST students pursuing post-matriculation courses (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Degree, PG, Professional courses)
schemes.description: The flagship Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs providing comprehensive financial support to ST students at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete higher education.
schemes.duration: Duration of the enrolled course (1 to 5 years)
eligibilityCriteria: Must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must be enrolled in Class 11, 12, ITI, Polytechnic, Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, or Doctoral program in an institution with a valid AISHE code.
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rs. 2.50 Lakh).
Must hold a valid Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Must have passed the qualifying previous examination.
All children of the same parents can be considered (subject to income ceiling).
requiredDocuments: ST / Caste Certificate (issued by competent authority)
Income Certificate for current academic year (from competent revenue authority)
Class 10 and Class 12 Marksheets / Passing Certificates
Institution Bonafide / Enrollment Certificate with AISHE code
Fee Structure Breakdown from Institution
Student Aadhaar Card
Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque (Aadhaar-seeded account)
Hostel Certificate (if applicable for hosteller rate allowance)
applicationProcedure: 1. Complete Student Profile in Tribal Scholar Saathi with tribal & academic details.
2. Connect DigiLocker to auto-verify Identity and Marksheets.
3. Choose Post-Matric Scholarship and input current course details.
4. Attach updated Income Certificate and Bonafide Certificate.
5. Submit application for College Nodal Officer verification.
verificationStages: Stage 1: Institute Verification by College Nodal Officer / Dean
Stage 2: District Welfare Office / State Department Verification
Stage 3: Sanction by State Tribal Welfare Department & MoTA
Stage 4: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) disbursement via PFMS
schemes.dbtInformation: Tuition fee component is credited directly to the institution or student account, and monthly maintenance allowance is credited directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via PFMS.
importantConditions: Maintenance allowance rates vary for Hostellers and Day Scholars.
Scholarship is discontinued if the student fails or abandons the course.
Change of course requires prior approval from State Department.

schemes.name: National Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class Education)
schemes.targetAudience: Meritorious ST students admitted to notified premier institutions (IITs, NITs, IIMs, NLUs, AIIMS, premier central universities)
schemes.description: Central Sector Scheme providing full financial support to meritorious ST students pursuing graduate and post-graduate courses in 250+ notified premier institutes of excellence across India.
schemes.duration: Full duration of the degree course
eligibilityCriteria: Must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must have secured admission in one of the notified premier institutes (IIT, NIT, IIM, AIIMS, NLU, etc.) through national competitive examinations (JEE, NEET, CAT, CLAT).
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 6,00,000 (Rs. 6.00 Lakh).
Scholarship is restricted to the maximum notified slots allocated to each institute per year.
requiredDocuments: ST / Caste Certificate
Income Certificate (Current financial year, <= Rs. 6 Lakh)
Institute Admission Offer Letter & Fee Receipt
Entrance Examination Scorecard / Rank Card (JEE / NEET / CAT / CLAT)
Class 12 Marksheet
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar-seeded)
applicationProcedure: 1. Complete Profile with Premier Institution details in Tribal Scholar Saathi.
2. Link DigiLocker to verify Caste and Identity.
3. Submit admission letter, rank card, and institutional fee schedule.
4. Application is routed to Premier Institute Nodal Officer.
5. On institutional verification, MoTA generates the sanction order.
verificationStages: Stage 1: Institutional Verification by Premier Institute Nodal Officer
Stage 2: MoTA Steering Committee scrutiny and slot allotment
Stage 3: Sanction Order issuance by Ministry of Tribal Affairs
Stage 4: Direct disbursement of tuition fee and student allowances via DBT
schemes.dbtInformation: Full non-refundable tuition fees are paid directly to the institute, while living expenses (Rs. 3,000/month), book allowance (Rs. 5,000/year), and one-time computer grant (Rs. 45,000) are disbursed via DBT to the student's bank account.
importantConditions: Student must maintain satisfactory academic standing as per institute norms.
Only valid for institutes notified under the Top Class scheme.
schemes.officialSource: MoTA Top Class Education Scheme Guidelines

schemes.name: National Fellowship for ST Students (NFST)
schemes.targetAudience: ST scholars pursuing full-time M.Phil and Ph.D degrees in recognized Indian universities
schemes.description: Central Sector fellowship scheme providing financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe candidates pursuing regular and full-time higher studies leading to M.Phil and Ph.D degrees in Sciences, Humanities, Engineering, and Social Sciences.
schemes.duration: Up to 5 Years (2 years JRF + 3 years SRF)
eligibilityCriteria: Must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must have qualified UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, or equivalent national eligibility test.
Must have secured regular, full-time admission in M.Phil / Ph.D in a UGC-recognized university / institution.
No income limit applies for this merit fellowship.
Candidate must not be in full-time gainful employment during the fellowship tenure.
requiredDocuments: ST Certificate
UGC-NET / CSIR-NET Scorecard and Award Letter
University Ph.D / M.Phil Admission / Registration Letter
Research Proposal / Synopsis approved by University
Recommendation from Research Supervisor and Head of Department
Aadhaar Card
Bank Passbook copy
applicationProcedure: 1. Complete Profile with research scholar credentials.
2. Submit NET scorecard, university registration, and research proposal.
3. University Nodal Officer verifies registration and attendance.
4. MoTA Fellowship Cell awards JRF/SRF sanction letter.
5. Monthly stipends are released based on quarterly supervisor progress reports.
verificationStages: Stage 1: University Research Department / Nodal Officer verification
Stage 2: MoTA Technical Evaluation and Award Letter issuance
Stage 3: Monthly Fellowship disbursement via DBT on PFMS portal
schemes.dbtInformation: Monthly fellowship (JRF: Rs. 37,000/month; SRF: Rs. 42,000/month) plus HRA and contingency grant (Rs. 25,000/year for science, Rs. 12,000/year for humanities) credited monthly via DBT.
importantConditions: Conversion from JRF to SRF requires completion of 2 years and evaluation by assessment committee.
Scholars must submit half-yearly progress reports certified by the guide.

schemes.name: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Candidates
schemes.targetAudience: Meritorious ST students pursuing Masters, Ph.D, or Post-Doctoral studies in top accredited foreign universities
schemes.description: Prestigious Central Sector Scheme providing comprehensive financial support to 20 meritorious Scheduled Tribe candidates each year to pursue Master level, Ph.D, and Post-Doctoral studies abroad in accredited institutions across USA, UK, Germany, Canada, Australia, etc.
schemes.duration: Masters: 2 to 3 Years | Ph.D: 4 to 5 Years
eligibilityCriteria: Must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must have secured unconditional admission offer from an institution ranked in the Top 500 QS World University Rankings.
Total annual family income must not exceed Rs. 6,00,000 (Rs. 6.00 Lakh).
Minimum 55% marks in qualifying Bachelor's / Master's degree.
Age below 35 years as on the first day of the application year.
Valid Indian Passport holder.
requiredDocuments: ST Certificate
Income Certificate for current financial year (<= Rs. 6.00 Lakh)
Unconditional Admission Offer Letter from Top 500 QS Foreign University
Valid Indian Passport (biographical pages)
GRE / GMAT / IELTS / TOEFL Scorecard
Qualifying Degree Marksheets and Degree Certificate
Statement of Purpose (SOP)
Aadhaar Card
applicationProcedure: 1. Register on Overseas Tribal Portal / Tribal Scholar Saathi.
2. Upload unconditional foreign admission letter and QS ranking verification.
3. Provide academic transcripts, SOP, and income documentation.
4. Interview and scrutiny by MoTA Overseas Selection Board.
5. Award letter generation and foreign currency fee transfer.
verificationStages: Stage 1: Document verification by MoTA Overseas Division
Stage 2: Scrutiny by MoTA Expert Selection Committee
Stage 3: Sanction Order and Visa facilitation letter issuance
Stage 4: Tuition fee disbursement directly to foreign university and living stipend via Indian Embassy / Mission
schemes.dbtInformation: Covers actual tuition fees paid to the foreign university, annual maintenance allowance (USD 15,400 for USA / GBP 9,900 for UK), contingency allowance, visa fees, economy air passage, and medical insurance.
importantConditions: Candidate must execute a bond to return to India after course completion.
